copy.headline: State of Texas: Agriculture commissioner-elect Clayton Tucker pushes for new data center rules

story.title: State of Texas: Agriculture commissioner-elect Clayton Tucker pushes for new data center rules
story.summary: As more data centers come to Texas, who gets a say in how much water they use? Democrat Clayton Tucker made that question part of his winning campaign for Texas agriculture commissioner.
